title: The Path to NDE 4.0: A Review of Algorithms, Techniques, and Strategies for Autonomous Inspection
abstract: arXiv:2610.31704v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Non-Destructive Inspection (NDI) is a cornerstone of modern quality assurance, critical for ensuring the safety and reliability of infrastructure and manufactured components without causing damage. This paper presents a comprehensive review of the current NDI landscape, analyzing the field through four distinct lenses, namely, computational algorithms, physical techniques, industrial applications, and research objectives. We synthesize a broad range of academic literature to illustrate the rapid evolution from manual, analog interpretation to a digitized, data-centric paradigm known as NDE 4.0. Our analysis highlights the dominance of ultrasound and visual inspection as primary physical techniques, while revealing a significant shift toward deep learning and generative models for automated defect recognition. translated_title: 迈向无损检测4.0之路：自主检测的算法、技术与策略综述
translated_abstract: 无损检测（NDI）是现代质量保证的基石，对于在不造成损坏的情况下确保基础设施和制造部件的安全性与可靠性至关重要。本文对当前无损检测领域进行了全面综述，从四个不同的视角对该领域进行分析，即计算算法、物理技术、工业应用和研究目标。我们综合了大量学术文献，以阐明该领域从手动、模拟解读向以数据为中心的数字化范式（即NDE 4.0）的快速演变。我们的分析突出了超声波和目视检测作为主要物理技术的主导地位，同时揭示了自动缺陷识别向深度学习和生成模型的重大转变。尽管取得了这些技术进步，但该行业仍面临关键瓶颈，特别是标准化开放获取数据的稀缺。
tldr: 本文从计算算法、物理技术、工业应用和研究目标四个视角全面综述了无损检测领域向NDE 4.0数字化数据驱动范式的演进，指出深度学习和生成模型正推动自动缺陷识别的发展，同时揭示标准化开放数据匮乏是行业面临的主要瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper comprehensively reviews the evolution of non-destructive inspection toward the digitized, data-centric NDE 4.0 paradigm through four lenses—algorithms, physical techniques, industrial applications, and research objectives—highlighting the shift toward deep learning and generative models for automated defect recognition while identifying the scarcity of standardized open-access data as a critical bottleneck.
